children: UK workforce benefits and insurance provider's H1 revenue grew 10% yr/yr, driven by record insurance sales
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 rose 22%, with basic EPS up 28% yr/yr
Company increased interim dividend by 10%, citing ongoing confidence in performance
Company expects full-year results to be in line with market expectations
Personal Group says recurring revenue base provides good visibility for remainder of FY 2026
Company plans to advance partnerships and invest in lead generation and workforce skills in H2
INSURANCE SALES - Record new business sales and higher average premiums drove 11% rise in insurance revenue
CLIENT EXPANSION - Increased penetration within existing clients and new client wins expanded addressable employee base
PARTNERSHIPS & PLATFORM - Strategic partnerships and platform enhancements supported lead generation and recurring revenue
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the life & health insurance peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Personal Group Holdings PLC is GBp465.00, about 15.5% above its September 14 closing price of GBp402.50
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
